# AudioManager

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Audio.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Audio.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Runtime/Scripts/Audio/AudioManager.cs#L34)

The audio module. Keeps a queue per [`AudioSource`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/AudioSource.html) so clips never talk over each
other, resolves localized audio through the Localization module, and can set the device volume
at startup. Registers itself as [`IAudioService`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/IAudioService).

The protected virtual members are the extension points: derive from this class to preset
sources, filter clips or react to playback.

```csharp
public class AudioManager : VRModule, IAudioService
```

### ApplySystemVolume() {#applysystemvolume}

Applies [`startVolume`](/api/vrframework-audio-runtime/AudioManager#startvolume) to the device. Does nothing in the editor, where the device

### QueueClip(AudioSource, AudioClip) {#queueclip-audiosource-audioclip}

Appends a clip to the queue of a source and starts the queue if it was idle. A null source, a
null clip or a clip rejected by [`ValidateClip(AudioClip)`](/api/vrframework-audio-runtime/AudioManager#validateclip-audioclip) is refused and logged.

```csharp
public int QueueClip(AudioSource source, AudioClip clip)
```

| `clip` | [`AudioClip`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/AudioClip.html) | Clip to queue. |

**Returns** [`int`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32) - The queue ID of the clip, or -1 when it was refused.
